notes: This is the v1 SEED for the declarative model registry (OT-P0-006).

Every operation has a CPU-capable DEFAULT chosen for the best normal-use quality on evidence, regardless of license class (operator stance 2026-11-21); license-clean rows stay selectable for monetized, hosted or redistributed use.

Policy: licenses gate only monetized, hosted and redistributed use; the shared rights evaluator (ai-provider-go/policy) applies them from each row's rights record. blocklist[] entries are either gate=license (gated_uses lists the refused uses; a seeded row with that id must carry rights that keep those uses refused) or gate=exclusion (exclusion_kind safety | technical | hardware_fit; never seeded).
Sizes and VRAM are APPROXIMATE (size_mb_approx, min_vram_gb) from public sources; verify at ingest.
New weight entries start with no checksum; after an acquired artifact is independently verified, pin its digest. Do NOT fabricate hashes.
Library-backed ops (Tesseract, goimagehash, gozxing, OpenCV) have no downloadable weights; checksum.status = 'n/a-library'.
checksum_policy: On first download of a model artifact, compute sha256, store it as source.checksum.value, and flip source.checksum.status to 'pinned'. Subsequent downloads must match the pinned hash or fail. Until then status is 'unverified-capture-on-download'.

field_reference.operations: ops this entry can serve (vocabulary SSOT: api/internal/operations)
field_reference.default_for: ops for which this entry is the seeded default (subset of operations)

field_reference.quant_variants: notable quantized/size variants and their approx sizes
field_reference.hardware: cpu_capable, gpu_required, min_vram_gb, min_ram_gb, os_arch, speed_note
field_reference.runtime: diffusers rows: family, pipeline_class, dtype, variant, min_runtime. Gateway-served vision rows (backend gateway-vision, or openrouter with a vision op): gateway_role names the AI Gateway role the model runs through (the gateway policy maps it to a concrete model); an object_detection row also sets box_order (xyxy or yxyx) and box_scale (the grid the model writes boxes on: 1000 for 0..1000, 0 for pixels)
field_reference.capability_labels: nsfw_capable, license, commercial_use(yes|no|conditional), commercial_use_notes, base_model_lineage, known_risks
field_reference.enabled: whether seeded enabled by default (a row seeded disabled must carry "disabled")
field_reference.disabled: required on every enabled=false row, forbidden on enabled rows: {kind: runtime|needs_install|hardware|superseded|candidate, reason: one line}.
